summary: Verified Header search bug fix on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All 4 scenarios passed: (1) magnifier click with 'Rumah Modern' navigates to /cari-properti?q=Rumah+Modern and shows 4 matching properties; (2) Enter key with 'Bogor' navigates to /cari-properti?q=Bogor; (3) Beli dropdown -> Sewa tab regression yields ?q=Jakarta&tab=sewa; (4) Mobile search submit navigates to /cari-properti?q=Depok. CariPropertiPage correctly reads q and tab query params via useSearchParams and applies filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx submitSearch implementation is clean; form onSubmit wraps both desktop and mobile variants correctly. Uses URLSearchParams for safe encoding and lowercases tab value only when not 'Beli' (default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header search fix (Header.jsx submitSearch + form wrappers + CariPropertiPage useSearchParams sync) is fully working across desktop and mobile. data-testids header-search-input/submit and header-search-input-mobile/submit-mobile are stable.
